name: Example Theme Hub
description: A hub of selectable viewer themes. Ships a catalog of three themes, lets the admin pick one from a panel, and applies the selected theme to the whole viewer UI through Owncast's core theming via the dynamic on_page_styles hook (no manifest styles file). A small on_page_scripts hook tags the page with the active theme id. Built as a template for a plugin that fetches a remote theme catalog. This example was written in Python.
